name: Kokoda Track
reason: 3 counted sources, 37890 page views

name: Owers' Corner
reason: Southern trailhead and start monument of the Kokoda Track, named by Wikivoyage and the national tourism site; a named access point every walk uses (passes 1-4).

name: Kokoda
reason: 2 counted sources, 4531 page views

name: Kokoda Gate
reason: Rule 3: a gateway sign in Kokoda town marking the track start; a minor landmark/photo stop that belongs to Kokoda town and the track. Only a photo caption in Wikivoyage, no coordinates.

name: Bomana War Cemetery
reason: Public Commonwealth war cemetery; Wikivoyage says every Kokoda trip stops there and calls it moving (passes 1-4: visitable, half hour or more, permanent).

name: Ioribaiwa Ridge
reason: Battle site reached by short treks from Owers' Corner per the national tourism site, so a possible day-walk draw (rule 3 vs track). One counted source, hard access.

name: Brigade Hill
reason: Memorial and WWII battle site on the track pictured by Wikivoyage; named battle site, but one source and it sits mid-track (about a day-plus from either end).

name: Imita Ridge
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right.

name: Ofi Creek
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right (creek crossing and campsite).

name: Templeton's Crossing
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right (creek crossing and campsite). Wikivoyage mentions it only in the day-by-day itinerary and safety sections.

name: Eora Creek
reason: Rule 1: no counted source after a second look (Wikivoyage only passes it in the itinerary, if at all); also part of the track.

name: Myola
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; dry lake bed on the track, part of the track (rule 3).

name: Menari
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right.

name: Nauro
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right.

name: Efogi
reason: Rule 3/2: village on the track; its museum is on Wikivoyage's list but 'not guaranteed to be open' (depends who has the key), so it is not a dependable visit and is part of the track.

name: Kagi
reason: part of the Kokoda Track (a larger spot), a village/campsite/ridge stop on the walk, not singled out by a counted source as a place in its own right (airstrip village).

name: Naduri
reason: Rule 1: no counted source (Wikipedia track article only); a village on the track.

name: Alola
reason: Rule 3/2: village on the track whose museum (one of four, Wikivoyage) is open only if the keyholder is present; part of the track.

name: Isurava
reason: Isurava memorial and museum, the war memorial site Wikivoyage singles out ('hard not to weep'), site of the 1942 battle; the best-known named battle site on the track (passes 1-4, the user's brief counts named battle sites).

name: Deniki
reason: Rule 3: battle site village on the track, named only in Wikivoyage's day-by-day example; part of the track with no separate visit.

name: Kokoda Airport
reason: Rule 2: airstrip, a transport point, not something to do or see.

name: Mount Bellamy
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; peak the track passes around.

name: Managalas Plateau
reason: Rule 1: no counted source after searching; sources describe a conservation area with a poor road and mostly defunct airstrips, no visitor infrastructure (rule 2 access).

name: Popondetta
reason: 2 counted sources, 4182 page views

name: Mount Lamington
reason: Two counted sources (national tourism site's Oro page and its Mount Lamington page): a dormant volcano and the 1951 eruption story, with memorial sites and small exhibits near Popondetta. But the page says climbing it is not common (safety and cultural reasons) and the memorials are in Popondetta, so the visit is a view plus memorials.

name: Tufi
reason: 3 counted sources, 1879 page views

name: Tufi Fjords
reason: Drowned fjords over 90 m deep, named by Wikivoyage 'See' and the tourism site's 'Tufi Fjords Experience' (two counted sources); cruise or kayak, a distinct scenic draw (passes 1-4).

name: Cyclone Reef
reason: Dive site named by Wikivoyage 'Do' (15 km from Tufi), with marine life and wrecks; one source, dive-boat only. Tufi's hammerhead diving is also on the tourism page.

name: Cape Nelson
reason: Headland named by the national tourism site (snorkelling, Korafe tapa and face tattooing cultural visits); one counted source and the culture is in villages, not at a defined point.

name: Mount Victory
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; volcano no visitor source names as a stop.

name: Buna
reason: The national tourism site's MUST SEE list says 'Visit Buna and Gona', WWII battlefields, memorials and relics; Buna has the 32nd Division memorial and relics (passes 1-4).

name: Gona
reason: Named in the same 'Visit Buna and Gona' MUST SEE line on the tourism site, WWII landing site and battleground (second-tier stop a real source names).

name: Gona Wreck
reason: Rule 1/3: no counted source, and the same place as Gona with no article of its own, so a duplicate.

name: Sanananda
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; battle ground village, Wikipedia only.

name: Buna Airfield
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; WWII airfield relic.

name: Oro Bay
reason: Rule 1/2: no counted source; a port bay with a PNG Ports wharf, not a visitor stop.

name: Collingwood Bay
reason: Rule 1: no counted source (Wikipedia and Pacific Wrecks only).

name: Mamba
reason: Rule 1/3: no counted source; a ward/village near Kokoda named only by Pacific Wrecks.

name: Afore
reason: Rule 1: no counted source (Wikipedia LLG title and an archive photo collection); a settlement.

name: Giropa Point
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; minor coastal point listed in Wikipedia's Oro Province article.

name: Mount Trafalgar
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; peak in Wikipedia's province category.

name: Cape Sudest
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; headland in Wikipedia's category.

name: Cape Ward Hunt
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; headland in Wikipedia's category.
